failed_run.observed: ZIP builder itself completed PASS and produced two CRC-PASS ZIPs plus manifest. Failure occurred at git add.
failed_run.root_cause: Repository .gitignore excludes ZIP files; plain git add returned exit code 1.
failed_run.evidence: Job log explicitly reported both PA8_D_*_INDEPENDENT_GENERATION_PACKAGE_R1.zip paths are ignored.

repair.change: Use git add -f for the two already-declared ZIP output paths.

lesson: When research artifacts intentionally include ZIP binaries in an ignored extension, use an explicit force-add or artifact store. A successful builder + CRC receipt must not be reclassified as scientific failure merely because repository ignore policy blocks commit.
